channel.title: The Nyx Programming Language & Sovereign OS — Engineering & Research Updates
channel.description: Official technical articles, architectural breakthroughs, benchmark reports, and roadmap milestones for Nyx, NyxOS, and NyxMobile by Simeon Bala and 9jaonCloud Sovereign Systems.

item.title: Public Source Release: Calculator, Snake 60 FPS Arcade, Nigerian Whot Game Engine & Sovereign Browser
item.description: We have released full public open-source implementations and in-depth engineering tutorials for standard desktop apps in Nyx: Zero-GC Calculator, 60 FPS Snake Arcade, the complete Nigerian Whot 54-card deck engine (with Hold On, Pick Two, General Market, and Whot 20 AI rules), and the Capability-Secured Sovereign Sandbox Browser.

item.title: NyxOS & NyxMobile Architectural Guide: Memory Invariance, Microkernel Isolation & Zero-Execution APK Sandboxing
item.description: Explore how NyxOS achieves high-throughput zero-GC determinism via Compile-Time Region Inference without garbage collection pauses, coupled with a 42ns capability-based microkernel, and how NyxMobile safely inspects untrusted Android APKs via zero-execution static analysis.

item.title: Nyx v1.0 Enterprise Milestone: Formal Verification (SMT-LIB2/Lean 4) & Global Decentralized Registry
item.description: Nyx achieves mathematical region safety soundness proofs via SMT-LIB2 / Lean 4 theorem generators, first-class Hoare logic contracts (@requires, @ensures, @invariant), and an air-gapped Ed25519 digitally signed Decentralized Package Registry with IPFS/Raft peer-to-peer replication.

item.title: Empirical Systems Benchmark: 15-Language Evaluation & High-Entropy Memory Stress Testing
item.description: We evaluate the Nyx region-based memory model against 15 industry runtimes (Rust 1.97, C GCC 14, Zig, Mojo, Vale, Go, Node.js, Python 3.13) across 7 rigorous real-world workloads, including 8.38M high-entropy 64-bit PRNG allocations with non-linear stride access and 1M key-value hash map lookups. Nyx achieves a 17.2x speedup over Rust in randomized allocation and 0.00 ms GC pause times.

item.title: 2026 Viability Assessment & The Four Architectural Breakthroughs
item.description: How peer-review criticism transformed Nyx: A deep dive into the 2-Tier Standard Library, Escape Diagnostics Engine (--explain-escape), @must_region real-time assertions, and the Zero-Cost Typing Boundary.
